description: This PHP class defines a Symfony console command named GenerateOpenApiDocCommand, which generates OpenAPI documentation for the OrangeHRM project. It scans specific directories for API specifications, generates a JSON OpenAPI definition, saves it to a file, and creates a Swagger UI HTML file with the embedded API definition.

classes.name: GenerateOpenApiDocCommand
classes.description: Defines a CLI command to generate OpenAPI documentation, handle errors, and produce JSON and HTML files.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up command options, notably adding a 'throw' option to convert warnings into errors.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Runs the command, scans directories for API specs, generates and saves the OpenAPI JSON, creates a Swagger UI HTML with the spec embedded, and handles errors if specified.
